name: open-autonomy-host
description: The project's runtime dependencies: the kit itself, whose keeper .open-autonomy/start.ts runs (pinned to the kit version this directory was rendered by), the Chat SDK and its Discord and Slack adapters for the orchestrator's and mail agents' channels, and World tooling for isolated application verification. Volter Harness (supercode), its orchestrator and its harness SDK are the machine's own, installed globally beside its machine daemon (machine-supercode.ts), never pinned here. The Open Autonomy SDK (the interface) is vendored beside them under sdk/; the host tools (the valve, the credential handoff, the Codex connection, the Volter Harness adapter) are the kit's own files here.
